words.english_meaning: The central part of a city, especially its main business area.
words.gujarati_meaning: શહેરનો મધ્ય / મુખ્ય વેપારી વિસ્તાર.
words.usage_note: American-style term; also an adverb ('go downtown'). UK often says 'city centre'.
examples: She works downtown in a tall office building.
Let's go downtown for dinner tonight.
The downtown area is full of shops and offices.
Traffic is heavy downtown during rush hour.

words.english_meaning: A residential area on the edge of a city, away from the centre.
words.gujarati_meaning: શહેરની બહારનો રહેણાંક વિસ્તાર / પરું.
words.usage_note: Often plural, 'the suburbs'. Adjective: 'suburban'.
examples: They moved to a quiet suburb last year.
Life in the suburbs is calmer than downtown.
The suburb has good schools and parks.
He commutes from the suburb to the city daily.

words.english_meaning: The outer parts of a town or city, far from the centre.
words.gujarati_meaning: શહેર કે ગામની બહારની હદ / છેવાડાનો વિસ્તાર.
words.usage_note: Always plural; usually 'on the outskirts of'.
examples: Their farm is on the outskirts of the city.
The airport lies on the outskirts of town.
Rents are cheaper on the outskirts.
We drove to the outskirts to escape the noise.

words.english_meaning: A district or area within a town, and the people who live there.
words.gujarati_meaning: આસપાસનો વિસ્તાર / પડોશ.
words.usage_note: Refers to both the place and its community. (US spelling: 'neighborhood'.)
examples: We live in a friendly neighbourhood.
There's a new café in the neighbourhood.
The whole neighbourhood came to the festival.
It's a safe neighbourhood for children.

words.english_meaning: A particular area or district of a town or region.
words.gujarati_meaning: ચોક્કસ વિસ્તાર / લત્તો.
words.usage_note: Slightly formal; common in Indian English for a residential area.
examples: Many old families live in this locality.
Is there a hospital in the locality?
The locality is known for its temples.
Property prices in this locality have risen.

words.english_meaning: A very large, busy, and important city.
words.gujarati_meaning: મોટું, ધમધમતું શહેર / મહાનગર.
words.usage_note: Formal/literary. Adjective: 'metropolitan'.
examples: Mumbai is a bustling metropolis.
The quiet town grew into a metropolis.
Living in a metropolis can be exhausting.
The metropolis never seems to sleep.

words.english_meaning: An area made up mainly of houses, where people live (not shops or factories).
words.gujarati_meaning: મુખ્યત્વે ઘરોવાળો રહેણાંક વિસ્તાર.
words.usage_note: Contrasted with 'commercial' or 'industrial' areas.
examples: They built a school in the residential area.
It's a quiet residential area with little traffic.
Shops are not allowed in this residential area.
The residential area is surrounded by gardens.

words.english_meaning: A building together with its land and surroundings, used by a business or person.
words.gujarati_meaning: મકાન અને તેની જમીન / મિલકતનો વિસ્તાર.
words.usage_note: Always plural in this sense. 'On the premises' = inside the building/grounds.
examples: Smoking is not allowed on the premises.
The company moved to larger premises.
Security guards patrol the premises at night.
Customers must leave the premises by ten.

words.english_meaning: A large entrance hall inside a hotel, office, or public building.
words.gujarati_meaning: હોટેલ/મકાનનો પ્રવેશખંડ.
words.usage_note: The first area you enter; often has reception and seating.
examples: Let's meet in the hotel lobby at nine.
The lobby was decorated with fresh flowers.
She waited in the lobby for her appointment.
The office lobby has comfortable sofas.

words.english_meaning: An entrance area or small lobby just inside the doors of a building, theatre, or home.
words.gujarati_meaning: પ્રવેશદ્વાર પાસેનો ખંડ / સ્વાગતકક્ષ.
words.usage_note: Often used for theatres/cinemas/large homes. (French; said 'FOY-ay'.)
examples: We met in the theatre foyer during the interval.
Guests gathered in the foyer before dinner.
The foyer leads into the main hall.
Leave your umbrella in the foyer.

words.english_meaning: A long passage inside a building, with rooms opening off it.
words.gujarati_meaning: મકાનની અંદરનો માર્ગ / પરસાળ.
words.usage_note: Connects rooms within a building (school, hospital, hotel).
examples: Her office is at the end of the corridor.
Students lined up in the corridor.
The hotel corridor was long and quiet.
We walked down the corridor to the exit.

words.english_meaning: A floor of a building that is partly or completely below ground level.
words.gujarati_meaning: જમીનની નીચેનો માળ / ભોંયરું.
words.usage_note: Often used for storage or parking.
examples: The car park is in the basement.
We store old boxes in the basement.
The basement stays cool in summer.
There's a gym in the building's basement.

words.english_meaning: An open, flat area on the roof of a building, or a raised paved area beside it.
words.gujarati_meaning: મકાનની ઉપરની ખુલ્લી છત / અગાશી.
words.usage_note: In Indian English often the rooftop; can also be a paved outdoor area.
examples: We had dinner on the terrace under the stars.
Children fly kites on the terrace.
The café has a lovely rooftop terrace.
She grows plants on her terrace.

words.english_meaning: An open area surrounded by walls or buildings, usually within or beside a building.
words.gujarati_meaning: મકાનની વચ્ચે દીવાલોથી ઘેરાયેલું ખુલ્લું આંગણું.
words.usage_note: Common in old houses, palaces, schools — an enclosed open space.
examples: The old house has a central courtyard.
Children played in the courtyard.
A fountain stood in the middle of the courtyard.
The temple's courtyard was full of pilgrims.

words.english_meaning: A building where journeys by air, bus, or sea begin and end.
words.gujarati_meaning: જ્યાં મુસાફરી શરૂ/પૂરી થાય તે મથક (એરપોર્ટ/બસ).
words.usage_note: Airports have several terminals; also 'bus terminal'.
words.memory_tip: મુસાફરી શરૂ/પૂરી થાય તે મથક = terminal.
examples: Our flight leaves from Terminal 2.
The bus terminal was crowded with travellers.
Check which terminal your airline uses.
We waited at the terminal for two hours.

words.english_meaning: A place where two or more roads or railway lines meet.
words.gujarati_meaning: જ્યાં રસ્તા કે રેલમાર્ગ મળે તે સ્થળ / સંગમ.
words.usage_note: For roads (intersection) or railways (a major station where lines meet).
examples: Turn right at the next junction.
It's a major railway junction.
There was an accident at the busy junction.
The two highways meet at this junction.

words.english_meaning: The raised area beside the track at a station where you get on or off a train.
words.gujarati_meaning: સ્ટેશન પર ગાડી પકડવા માટેનો ઉંચો ઓટલો / પ્લેટફોર્મ.
words.usage_note: Trains arrive 'at' a platform; e.g. 'platform 4'.
words.memory_tip: સ્ટેશન પર ગાડી પકડવાનો ઓટલો = platform.
examples: The train arrives at platform three.
We waited on the platform in the cold.
Mind the gap between the train and the platform.
Passengers crowded the platform at rush hour.

words.english_meaning: A place where buses, trains, or goods are kept, parked, or stored.
words.gujarati_meaning: બસ/સામાન રાખવાનું મથક / ડેપો.
words.usage_note: For storage or for parking/maintaining vehicles. (Said 'DEE-poh'.)
examples: The buses return to the depot at night.
Goods are stored at the railway depot.
He works as a mechanic at the bus depot.
The depot houses over a hundred buses.

words.english_meaning: A small house or place to stay, often in the countryside or at the entrance to an estate.
words.gujarati_meaning: રહેવા માટેનું નાનું મકાન (ખાસ ગ્રામ્ય વિસ્તારમાં).
words.usage_note: Often a holiday/rest place in nature; also a gatekeeper's small house.
words.memory_tip: ગ્રામ્ય વિસ્તારમાં રહેવાનું નાનું મકાન = lodge.
examples: We stayed in a cosy lodge in the hills.
The safari lodge overlooked a river.
A ski lodge stood at the foot of the mountain.
The guard lives in the lodge by the gate.

words.english_meaning: A place providing cheap accommodation, especially for students or travellers.
words.gujarati_meaning: મુસાફરો/વિદ્યાર્થીઓ માટેનું સસ્તું રહેઠાણ.
words.usage_note: Budget lodging with shared facilities; common for students/backpackers.
examples: Backpackers often stay in a hostel.
She lives in a student hostel near campus.
The youth hostel was clean and cheap.
We booked a hostel for the weekend trip.

words.english_meaning: A shop where medicines are prepared and sold.
words.gujarati_meaning: દવાની દુકાન / કેમિસ્ટ.
words.usage_note: UK 'chemist's', US 'drugstore'. The person is a 'pharmacist'.
examples: I bought the medicine from the pharmacy.
Is there a pharmacy open at night?
The pharmacy is next to the clinic.
The pharmacist explained how to take the tablets.

words.english_meaning: A small open-fronted stall or booth where things are sold or information is given.
words.gujarati_meaning: નાનો સ્ટોલ / કેબિન જ્યાં વસ્તુ વેચાય.
words.usage_note: Small, often standalone; sells newspapers, snacks, tickets, etc.
examples: I bought a magazine from the kiosk.
There's a ticket kiosk near the gate.
The kiosk sells snacks and cold drinks.
She runs a small kiosk at the station.

words.english_meaning: A shop or store, especially one that sells a particular brand's goods.
words.gujarati_meaning: દુકાન / વેચાણકેન્દ્ર (ખાસ બ્રાન્ડનું).
words.usage_note: 'Factory outlet' sells at lower prices; 'retail outlet' = a shop.
examples: There's a new outlet of that brand in the mall.
We bought shoes at the factory outlet.
The company has outlets across the country.
This outlet offers great discounts.

words.english_meaning: A local office or shop that is part of a larger company or organisation.
words.gujarati_meaning: મોટી કંપનીની સ્થાનિક ઓફિસ / શાખા.
words.usage_note: 'Head office' is the main one; 'branches' are the local ones.
examples: I opened an account at the local bank branch.
The store has branches in every city.
Our nearest branch is on Main Street.
She manages the branch office downtown.

words.english_meaning: A large building where goods are stored before being sold or sent out.
words.gujarati_meaning: સામાન સંગ્રહવાનું મોટું ગોદામ.
words.usage_note: In Indian English, 'godown' is a common equivalent.
examples: The goods are kept in a large warehouse.
Workers loaded boxes onto trucks at the warehouse.
The warehouse stores furniture and appliances.
Online orders are shipped from this warehouse.

words.english_meaning: A small shop selling fashionable clothes or accessories.
words.gujarati_meaning: નાની, ફેશનેબલ દુકાન.
words.usage_note: Implies small, stylish, often expensive. (French; said 'boo-TEEK'.)
examples: She bought a dress from a designer boutique.
A new boutique opened in the market.
The boutique sells handmade jewellery.
Prices at the boutique are quite high.

words.english_meaning: A shop that sells food and small household goods.
words.gujarati_meaning: કરિયાણાની દુકાન.
words.usage_note: 'The grocer's' = the shop; 'grocer' = the shopkeeper. US: 'grocery store'.
examples: I'm going to the grocer's for some milk.
The grocer's on the corner stays open late.
She buys vegetables from the local grocer's.
We ran out of sugar, so I went to the grocer's.

words.english_meaning: Full of busy, lively activity and lots of people.
words.gujarati_meaning: ધમધમતું, ભીડભાડ અને ચહલપહલવાળું.
words.usage_note: Positive: energetic and full of life.
examples: The market was bustling with shoppers.
She loves the bustling streets of the old city.
It's a bustling town full of energy.
The station was bustling during the festival.

words.english_meaning: Attractively old-fashioned in an unusual and charming way.
words.gujarati_meaning: જૂની ઢબનું છતાં આકર્ષક / મનમોહક.
words.usage_note: Positive — pleasantly old-fashioned (cottages, villages, lanes).
examples: They stayed in a quaint little village.
The town is full of quaint old cottages.
We browsed the quaint shops along the lane.
It's a quaint café with vintage decor.

words.english_meaning: Visually attractive, like a picture; charming scenery.
words.gujarati_meaning: ચિત્ર જેવું સુંદર / રમણીય (ખાસ દૃશ્ય).
words.usage_note: Usually about places/scenery that look beautiful.
examples: The village sits in a picturesque valley.
We drove along a picturesque coastal road.
The lake offers picturesque views.
It's a picturesque spot for photos.

words.english_meaning: Private and quiet; far away from other people.
words.gujarati_meaning: એકાંત, લોકોથી દૂર અને શાંત.
words.usage_note: Often positive — peaceful privacy.
examples: We found a secluded beach with no crowds.
Their house is in a secluded part of the hills.
She enjoys the secluded garden behind her home.
It's a secluded spot, perfect for reading.

words.english_meaning: In poor condition because of neglect; old and shabby.
words.gujarati_meaning: જર્જરિત, બિસ્માર હાલતમાં.
words.usage_note: Negative — neglected and in disrepair.
examples: They bought a run-down house and repaired it.
The factory was old and run-down.
It used to be a run-down area, now it's modern.
The hotel looked run-down and dirty.

words.english_meaning: Having plenty of space; large and roomy.
words.gujarati_meaning: વિશાળ, પૂરતી જગ્યાવાળું.
words.usage_note: Positive — comfortably large.
examples: The new flat is bright and spacious.
They have a spacious living room.
The hall was spacious enough for 200 guests.
I prefer a spacious office to a cramped one.

words.english_meaning: Empty, with no people present.
words.gujarati_meaning: સૂનું, માણસો વગરનું / નિર્જન.
words.usage_note: Means temporarily empty or abandoned of people.
examples: The streets were deserted late at night.
We found a deserted beach.
The old village is now completely deserted.
At noon the office looked deserted.

words.english_meaning: A very short distance away; very close.
words.gujarati_meaning: તદ્દન નજીક / હાથવેંતમાં.
words.usage_note: Informal idiom for 'very near'.
examples: The beach is just a stone's throw away from our hotel.
The school is a stone's throw away from home.
Shops are a stone's throw away.
It's only a stone's throw from the station.

words.english_meaning: In a remote, quiet place away from popular or busy routes.
words.gujarati_meaning: મુખ્ય રસ્તાથી દૂર, અજાણ્યું એકાંત સ્થળ.
words.usage_note: Idiom; often positive for travellers wanting quiet, unusual spots.
words.memory_tip: મુખ્ય રસ્તાથી દૂરનું = off the beaten track.
examples: We like holidays off the beaten track.
The village is off the beaten track and very peaceful.
For real adventure, go off the beaten track.
This café is off the beaten track but worth finding.

words.english_meaning: In the very centre or most important part of a place.
words.gujarati_meaning: ના બરાબર મધ્યમાં / કેન્દ્રમાં.
collocations: in the heart of the city
words.usage_note: Emphasises a central, lively location.
words.memory_tip: બરાબર મધ્યમાં = in the heart of.
examples: The hotel is in the heart of the city.
Their shop is in the heart of the market.
We stayed in the heart of the old town.
The park lies in the heart of the campus.

words.english_meaning: Close enough to be reached easily on foot.
words.gujarati_meaning: ચાલીને પહોંચાય એટલું નજીક.
words.usage_note: Use 'within walking distance OF' a place.
words.memory_tip: ચાલીને પહોંચાય એટલું નજીક = within walking distance.
examples: The market is within walking distance of my house.
Everything we need is within walking distance.
The office is within walking distance from the station.
We chose a hotel within walking distance of the beach.

words.english_meaning: Very far from any town or other people; extremely remote.
words.gujarati_meaning: દરેક વસ્તીથી દૂર, અતિ દૂરનું.
words.usage_note: Informal; emphasises isolation.
words.memory_tip: દરેક વસ્તીથી દૂર = miles from anywhere.
examples: Their farmhouse is miles from anywhere.
We broke down miles from anywhere.
The resort felt miles from anywhere, totally peaceful.
It's a lonely cottage, miles from anywhere.

words.english_meaning: Very close to where you live or are; right nearby.
words.gujarati_meaning: બારણા આગળ જ / એકદમ નજીક.
words.usage_note: Idiom — so near it's almost at your door. Often 'right on the doorstep'.
words.memory_tip: બારણા આગળ જ = on the doorstep.
examples: We have a beautiful park right on our doorstep.
The beach is on our doorstep.
Good schools are on the doorstep here.
With the station on the doorstep, commuting is easy.

words.english_meaning: The outline of a city's buildings and other structures when viewed from a distance.
words.gujarati_meaning: દૂરથી જોતાં શહેરના મકાનો અને અન્ય રચનાઓની રેખાચિત્ર.
words.usage_note: The term 'skyline' is often used to describe the visual appearance of a city.
words.memory_tip: 'sky' = આભ થી 'line' = રેખા -> આભની રેખા એટલે સ્કાયલાઇન
examples: The city's skyline is dominated by the skyscraper.
The skyline of the city is very beautiful.
The skyline view from the top of the hill is amazing.
The skyline of the city has changed a lot in recent years.

words.english_meaning: An open area in a town or city, often surrounded by buildings and used for public gatherings.
words.gujarati_meaning: શહેરમાં ખુલ્લી જગ્યા, ઘણીવાર ઇમારતોથી ઘેરાયેલી અને જાહેર સમારોહ માટે વપરાય છે.
words.usage_note: A plaza is often used as a meeting place for people.
examples: The plaza is a popular spot for street performers.
The city's main plaza is surrounded by historic buildings.
The plaza is a great place to people-watch.
The new plaza in the city is very modern and beautiful.

words.english_meaning: The area where a city or town meets a body of water, such as a river, lake, or sea.
words.gujarati_meaning: શહેર અથવા નગર જ્યાં પાણીના સ્ત્રોત સાથે મળે છે, જેમકે નદી, તળાવ અથવા સમુદ્ર.
words.usage_note: The waterfront is often a popular area for recreation and tourism.
words.memory_tip: 'water' = પાણી અને 'front' = આગળ -> પાણીનો આગળનો ભાગ એટલે વોટરફ્રન્ટ
examples: The city's waterfront is a popular spot for walking and cycling.
The waterfront area is being redeveloped with new shops and restaurants.
The waterfront view from the hotel room is stunning.
The waterfront park is a great place for a picnic.

words.english_meaning: A notable or famous building, monument, or other structure that is easily recognizable.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક નોંધપાત્ર અથવા પ્રખ્યાત ઇમારત, સ્મારક અથવા અન્ય રચના જે સરળતાથી ઓળખી શકાય છે.
words.usage_note: Landmarks are often used as navigational aids.
words.memory_tip: 'land' = જમીન અને 'mark' = ચિહ્ન -> જમીનનું ચિહ્ન એટલે લેન્ડમાર્ક
examples: The Eiffel Tower is a famous landmark in Paris.
The city's landmark building is the town hall.
The landmark monument is a symbol of the city's history.
The landmark hotel is a popular spot for tourists.

words.english_meaning: A person who is walking, especially in a town or city.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક વ્યક્તિ જે ચાલી રહ્યો છે, ખાસ કરીને શહેર અથવા નગરમાં.
words.usage_note: Pedestrians often have to be careful when crossing roads.
words.memory_tip: 'ped' = પગ અને 'estrian' = ચાલનાર -> પગથી ચાલનાર એટલે પેડેસ્ટ્રિયન
examples: The pedestrian crossed the road carefully.
The city has a pedestrian zone in the center.
The pedestrian bridge is a popular spot for walking.
The pedestrian traffic is very heavy during rush hour.

words.english_meaning: A road or path that passes under another road or railway.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક રસ્તો અથવા માર્ગ જે અન્ય રસ્તો અથવા રેલ્વે નીચેથી પસાર થાય છે.
words.usage_note: Underpasses are often used to reduce traffic congestion.
words.memory_tip: 'under' = નીચે અને 'pass' = પસાર થવું -> નીચેથી પસાર થવું એટલે અંડરપાસ
examples: The underpass is a convenient way to cross the busy road.
The city has several underpasses to reduce traffic congestion.
The underpass is a popular spot for street artists.
The underpass is well-lit and safe for pedestrians.

words.english_meaning: A circular intersection where traffic flows continuously in one direction.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક વર્તુળાકાર છેડા જ્યાં ટ્રાફિક એક દિશામાં સતત વહે છે.
words.usage_note: Roundabouts are often used to reduce traffic congestion and improve safety.
words.memory_tip: 'round' = વર્તુળ અને 'about' = આસપાસ -> વર્તુળમાં આસપાસ ફરવું એટલે રાઉન્ડઅબાઉટ
examples: The roundabout is a busy intersection in the city.
The roundabout is a great way to reduce traffic congestion.
The roundabout is a popular spot for street performers.
The roundabout is well-designed and safe for drivers.

words.english_meaning: A wide, tree-lined street, often in a city or town.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક પહોળો, વૃક્ષોથી ઘેરાયેલો રસ્તો, ઘણીવાર શહેર અથવા નગરમાં.
words.usage_note: Boulevards are often used for recreational purposes.
words.memory_tip: 'bou' = પહોળો અને 'levard' = રસ્તો -> પહોળો રસ્તો એટલે બુલેવર્ડ
examples: The boulevard is a popular spot for walking and cycling.
The city's main boulevard is lined with trees and shops.
The boulevard is a great place for a leisurely stroll.
The boulevard is well-lit and safe at night.

words.english_meaning: A wide, landscaped road, often in a park or other scenic area.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક પહોળો, દૃશ્યાત્મક રસ્તો, ઘણીવાર ઉદ્યાન અથવા અન્ય દૃશ્યાત્મક વિસ્તારમાં.
words.usage_note: Parkways are often used for recreational driving.
words.memory_tip: 'park' = ઉદ્યાન અને 'way' = રસ્તો -> ઉદ્યાનનો રસ્તો એટલે પાર્કવે
examples: The parkway is a popular spot for Sunday drives.
The city's parkway is lined with trees and gardens.
The parkway is a great place for a leisurely drive.
The parkway is well-maintained and safe for drivers.

words.english_meaning: An entrance or a point of access to a city, town, or other area.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક પ્રવેશદ્વાર અથવા શહેર, નગર અથવા અન્ય વિસ્તારમાં પ્રવેશ કરવાનું સ્થાન.
words.usage_note: Gateways are often used to mark the entrance to a city or town.
words.memory_tip: 'gate' = દરવાજો અને 'way' = રસ્તો -> દરવાજોથી રસ્તો એટલે ગેટવે
examples: The gateway to the city is a beautiful arch.
The town's gateway is marked by a sign.
The gateway is a popular spot for tourists.
The gateway is well-designed and safe for pedestrians.

words.english_meaning: The front of a building, especially a large or impressive one.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઇમારતનો સામેનો ભાગ, ખાસ કરીને મોટી અથવા આકર્ષક ઇમારત.
words.usage_note: Often used in architectural contexts to describe the front of a building.
examples: The building's facade was designed by a famous architect.
The old facade of the church was restored to its original state.
The hotel's facade was covered in ivy and looked very picturesque.
The company's new headquarters has a striking facade made of glass and steel.

words.english_meaning: A window that projects from a sloping roof.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઢાળવાળી છત પરથી આગળ નીકળેલું બારી.
words.usage_note: Often used in architectural contexts to describe a type of window.
examples: The attic room had a dormer window with a beautiful view of the city.
The old house had several dormers that let in plenty of natural light.
The dormer on the roof was designed to provide more space in the attic.
The architect included a dormer in the design to add visual interest to the facade.

words.english_meaning: The underside of a roof or a bridge, especially the part that is visible from below.
words.gujarati_meaning: છત અથવા પુલની નીચેની બાજુ, ખાસ કરીને નીચેથી જોઈ શકાય તે ભાગ.
words.usage_note: Often used in architectural and construction contexts.
examples: The soffit of the roof was made of wood and needed to be replaced.
The soffit of the bridge was covered in rust and needed to be repaired.
The architect designed the soffit to be visible from the street.
The soffit ventilation system helped to reduce the risk of moisture damage.

words.english_meaning: A horizontal beam that spans an opening, such as a door or window.
words.gujarati_meaning: દરવાજા અથવા બારી જેવી ખુલ્લી જગ્યા પર આડી રીતે પથરાયેલો બાળુ.
words.usage_note: Often used in architectural and construction contexts.
examples: The lintel above the door was carved with intricate designs.
The lintel beam was made of steel and supported the weight of the wall.
The architect designed the lintel to be decorative as well as functional.
The lintel was damaged in the earthquake and needed to be replaced.

words.english_meaning: A vertical bar that divides a window or a door into separate sections.
words.gujarati_meaning: બારી અથવા દરવાજાને અલગ અલગ ભાગોમાં વિભાજિત કરતો ઉભો બારી.
words.usage_note: Often used in architectural and construction contexts.
examples: The mullions on the window were made of wood and added a touch of elegance.
The mullion on the door was decorative and served no functional purpose.
The architect designed the mullions to be thin and unobtrusive.
The mullions were removed to create a more open and airy feel in the room.

words.english_meaning: A wall or barrier that is built along the edge of a roof, bridge, or other structure.
words.gujarati_meaning: છત, પુલ અથવા અન્ય રચનાની ધાર પર બાંધવામાં આવેલી દિવાલ અથવા અવરોધ.
words.usage_note: Often used in architectural and construction contexts.
words.memory_tip: 'parapet' = ધારની દિવાલ -> છતની ધાર પર બાંધવામાં આવેલી દિવાલ
examples: The parapet on the roof was designed to prevent people from falling off.
The parapet on the bridge was made of stone and had a decorative railing.
The architect included a parapet in the design to add a sense of security.
The parapet was damaged in the storm and needed to be repaired.

words.english_meaning: A rectangular column that is attached to a wall and projects slightly from it.
words.gujarati_meaning: દિવાલ સાથે જોડાયેલો અને થોડો બહાર નીકળેલો આયતાકાર સ્તંભ.
words.usage_note: Often used in architectural contexts to describe a decorative element.
words.memory_tip: 'pilaster' = દિવાલ સાથે જોડાયેલો સ્તંભ -> આયતાકાર સ્તંભ
examples: The pilasters on the wall were made of marble and added a touch of elegance.
The pilaster on the corner of the building was decorative and served no functional purpose.
The architect designed the pilasters to be thin and unobtrusive.
The pilasters were removed to create a more open and airy feel in the room.

words.english_meaning: A flat base or platform that supports a column, statue, or other structure.
words.gujarati_meaning: સ્તંભ, મૂર્તિ અથવા અન્ય રચનાને આધાર આપતી સપાટ આધાર અથવા મંચ.
words.usage_note: Often used in architectural and construction contexts.
examples: The plinth of the statue was made of granite and had a decorative design.
The plinth of the column was cracked and needed to be repaired.
The architect designed the plinth to be strong and durable.
The plinth was covered in ivy and looked very picturesque.

words.english_meaning: A covered entrance to a building, typically with a roof and columns.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઇમારતનો ઢાંકવામાં આવેલો પ્રવેશદ્વાર, સામાન્ય રીતે છત અને સ્તંભો સાથે.
words.usage_note: Often used in architectural contexts to describe a decorative element.
words.memory_tip: 'portico' = ઢાંકવામાં આવેલો પ્રવેશદ્વાર -> છત અને સ્તંભો સાથે
examples: The portico of the building was designed to be impressive and grand.
The portico was made of marble and had a decorative roof.
The architect included a portico in the design to add a sense of elegance.
The portico was damaged in the storm and needed to be repaired.

words.english_meaning: A horizontal beam that spans an opening, such as a door or window, and is typically located above the lintel.
words.gujarati_meaning: દરવાજા અથવા બારી જેવી ખુલ્લી જગ્યા પર આડી રીતે પથરાયેલો બાળુ, સામાન્ય રીતે લિન્ટેલની ઉપર.
words.usage_note: Often used in architectural and construction contexts.
examples: The transom above the door was made of wood and had a decorative design.
The transom window was opened to let in some fresh air.
The architect designed the transom to be strong and durable.
The transom was damaged in the storm and needed to be repaired.

words.english_meaning: A planned route or journey, or a list of places to visit.
words.gujarati_meaning: પ્રવાસનો આયોજિત માર્ગ અથવા મુસાફરી, અથવા મુલાકાત લેવાના સ્થળોની યાદી.
words.usage_note: Often used in formal or business contexts.
examples: The travel agent helped us create an itinerary for our trip to Europe.
The company's itinerary included meetings with several potential clients.
She spent hours planning the perfect itinerary for her honeymoon.
The tour group followed a strict itinerary to ensure they saw all the major sights.

words.english_meaning: The act of arriving at a hotel, airport, or other location and registering or announcing your presence.
words.gujarati_meaning: હોટલ, એરપોર્ટ અથવા અન્ય સ્થળે આગમન અને નોંધણી કરવી અથવા હાજરી જાહેર કરવી.
words.usage_note: Often used in formal or official contexts.
examples: The check-in time at the hotel is 3 pm.
She forgot to check-in for her flight and missed it.
The check-in process at the airport was very efficient.
The hotel offers online check-in to speed up the registration process.

words.english_meaning: The act of getting on a vehicle, such as a plane, train, or bus.
words.gujarati_meaning: વાહન, જેમ કે વિમાન, ટ્રેન અથવા બસ, પર ચડવાની ક્રિયા.
words.usage_note: Often used in formal or official contexts.
examples: The boarding process for the flight was very slow.
She forgot her boarding pass and had to go back to the check-in desk.
The boarding gate for the train is closing in 10 minutes.
The airline offers priority boarding for its premium passengers.

words.english_meaning: The act of leaving a place, such as a city, airport, or station.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક સ્થળ છોડવાની ક્રિયા, જેમ કે શહેર, એરપોર્ટ અથવા સ્ટેશન.
words.usage_note: Often used in formal or official contexts.
examples: The departure time for the flight is 10 am.
The departure gate for the train is changing to platform 3.
The hotel offers a free shuttle service to the airport for departure.
The departure tax for international flights is very high.

words.english_meaning: The act of passing through a place, or a period of time spent traveling from one place to another.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક સ્થળમાંથી પસાર થવાની ક્રિયા, અથવા એક સ્થળથી બીજા સ્થળે જવા માટેનો સમય.
words.usage_note: Often used in formal or official contexts.
examples: The transit time for the package was very long.
The transit visa for the country is required for all travelers.
The company offers a free transit service for its employees.
The transit system in the city is very efficient.

words.english_meaning: A way or course taken to get from one place to another.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક સ્થળથી બીજા સ્થળે જવા માટેનો માર્ગ અથવા માર્ગ.
words.usage_note: Often used in formal or official contexts.
examples: The route to the airport is very congested.
The GPS suggested a new route to avoid traffic.
The company is changing its route to reduce costs.
The hikers got lost because they took a wrong route.

words.english_meaning: The place to which someone or something is going or being sent.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક વ્યક્તિ અથવા વસ્તુ જતા અથવા મોકલાતા સ્થળ.
words.usage_note: Often used in formal or official contexts.
examples: The destination of the flight was Paris.
The company's destination is to become the market leader.
The tourist's destination was the beach resort.
The package was sent to the wrong destination.

words.english_meaning: The act of traveling from one place to another.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક સ્થળથી બીજા સ્થળે જવાની ક્રિયા.
words.usage_note: Often used in formal or official contexts.
examples: The journey to the mountains was very tiring.
The company offers a journey planner to its employees.
The journey of the spaceship took several years.
The journey of life is full of ups and downs.

words.english_meaning: An official document that identifies a person as a citizen of a country and allows them to travel abroad.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક અધિકૃત દસ્તાવેજ જે એક વ્યક્તિને એક દેશના નાગરિક તરીકે ઓળખે છે અને તેમને વિદેશમાં મુસાફરી કરવાની મંજૂરી આપે છે.
words.usage_note: Often used in formal or official contexts.
examples: She forgot her passport at home and couldn't travel.
The passport application process is very complicated.
The new passport has a biometric chip for added security.
The passport photo must be recent and clear.

words.english_meaning: An official document that gives someone permission to enter or stay in a country for a specific period of time.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક અધિકૃત દસ્તાવેજ જે એક વ્યક્તિને એક દેશમાં પ્રવેશ કરવા અથવા રોકાણ કરવાની મંજૂરી આપે છે.
words.usage_note: Often used in formal or official contexts.
examples: She applied for a visa to study in the US.
The visa requirements for the country are very strict.
The visa fee for the tourist visa is very high.
The visa application process took several months.

words.english_meaning: A large store that sells a wide range of goods, including clothing, furniture, and household items.
words.gujarati_meaning: વિવિધ પ્રકારના વસ્ત્રો, ફર્નિચર અને ઘરેલુ સામાન વેચતું મોટું સ્ટોર.
words.usage_note: Often used to describe a large store with multiple floors and a wide range of products.
words.memory_tip: 'depart' = અલગ થવું -> department store = વિવિધ વસ્તુઓનું સ્ટોર
examples: I'm going to the department store to buy a new shirt.
The department store is having a sale on all winter clothing.
She works at the department store in the cosmetics section.
The department store is open from 9 am to 9 pm.

words.english_meaning: A store that sells books, often with a wide selection of titles and genres.
words.gujarati_meaning: પુસ્તકો વેચતું સ્ટોર, ઘણીવાર વિવિધ શૈલીઓ અને વિષયોના પુસ્તકો હોય છે.
words.usage_note: Often used to describe a store that specializes in selling books, as opposed to a general store that also sells books.
examples: I love spending hours in the bookshop, browsing through the shelves.
The bookshop is having a sale on all bestselling novels.
She works at the bookshop, helping customers find the perfect book.
The bookshop is a great place to attend author readings and signings.

words.english_meaning: A large store that sells a wide range of food and household products.
words.gujarati_meaning: ખોરાક અને ઘરેલુ ઉત્પાદનો વેચતું મોટું સ્ટોર.
words.usage_note: Often used to describe a large store that sells a wide range of products, including fresh produce, meat, dairy products, and household essentials.
examples: I'm going to the supermarket to buy some milk and eggs.
The supermarket is having a sale on all organic products.
She works at the supermarket, restocking shelves and helping customers.
The supermarket is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

words.english_meaning: A place where clothes are washed and cleaned, or the clothes that need to be washed.
words.gujarati_meaning: કપડાં ધોવાનું સ્થળ, અથવા ધોવાના કપડાં.
words.usage_note: Often used to describe a place where clothes are washed and cleaned, or the act of washing and cleaning clothes.
examples: I need to take my clothes to the laundry to get them cleaned.
The laundry is open from 8 am to 8 pm, 7 days a week.
She works at the laundry, washing and folding clothes all day.
The laundry service is very convenient, they pick up and deliver your clothes.

words.english_meaning: A room or building where food and drinks are served, often in a school, hospital, or office building.
words.gujarati_meaning: ખોરાક અને પીણાં પીરસવામાં આવતા ઓરડા અથવા ઇમારત, ઘણીવાર શાળા, હોસ્પિટલ અથવા ઓફિસ બિલ્ડિંગમાં.
words.usage_note: Often used to describe a room or building where food and drinks are served, often in a school, hospital, or office building.
examples: The cafeteria is open for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.
I'm meeting my friends in the cafeteria to study for our exam.
She works in the cafeteria, serving food to students and staff.
The cafeteria has a variety of food options, including vegetarian and vegan dishes.

words.english_meaning: A person who makes, sells, or repairs jewelry, or a store that sells jewelry.
words.gujarati_meaning: ગહનાં બનાવતો, વેચતો અથવા સરવાળો કરતો વ્યક્તિ, અથવા ગહનાં વેચતું સ્ટોર.
collocations: get a piece appraised by a jeweler
words.usage_note: Often used to describe a person who makes, sells, or repairs jewelry, or a store that sells jewelry.
examples: I'm going to the jeweler to get my ring resized.
The jeweler is having a sale on all diamond necklaces.
She works at the jeweler, helping customers find the perfect piece of jewelry.
The jeweler is known for its high-quality and unique designs.

words.english_meaning: A person who cuts, styles, and grooms hair, especially for men, or a shop where such services are provided.
words.gujarati_meaning: વાળ કાપતો, સ્ટાઇલ કરતો અને સંભાળતો વ્યક્તિ, ખાસ કરીને પુરુષો માટે, અથવા અવા સેવાઓ પૂરી પાડતું સ્થળ.
words.usage_note: Often used to describe a person who cuts, styles, and grooms hair, especially for men, or a shop where such services are provided.
examples: I need to go to the barber to get a haircut.
The barber is very skilled and always gives a great shave.
She works at the barber shop, cutting and styling hair all day.
The barber shop is a great place to catch up on the latest sports news.

words.english_meaning: A person who sells and arranges flowers, or a shop that sells flowers and other plants.
words.gujarati_meaning: ફૂલો વેચતો અને ગોઠવતો વ્યક્તિ, અથવા ફૂલો અને અન્ય છોડ વેચતું સ્ટોર.
words.usage_note: Often used to describe a person who sells and arranges flowers, or a shop that sells flowers and other plants.
examples: I'm going to the florist to buy some flowers for my girlfriend.
The florist is having a sale on all roses and carnations.
She works at the florist, arranging and selling flowers all day.
The florist is known for its beautiful and unique arrangements.

words.english_meaning: A person who sells and fits eyeglasses and contact lenses, or a shop that sells such products.
words.gujarati_meaning: ચશ્માં અને કૉન્ટેક્ટ લેન્સ વેચતો અને પહેરાવતો વ્યક્તિ, અથવા અવા ઉત્પાદનો વેચતું સ્ટોર.
words.usage_note: Often used to describe a person who sells and fits eyeglasses and contact lenses, or a shop that sells such products.
examples: I need to go to the optician to get my eyes checked.
The optician is having a sale on all designer glasses.
She works at the optician, helping customers choose the right frames.
The optician is known for its wide selection of contact lenses and solutions.

words.english_meaning: A company that helps people plan and book trips, vacations, and other travel arrangements.
words.gujarati_meaning: લોકોને પ્રવાસ, રજાઓ અને અન્ય પ્રવાસની વ્યવસ્થા કરવામાં મદદ કરતી કંપની.
collocations: plan a trip with a travel agency
get travel advice from a travel agency
words.usage_note: Often used to describe a company that helps people plan and book trips, vacations, and other travel arrangements.
words.memory_tip: 'travel' = પ્રવાસ -> travel agency = પ્રવાસની વ્યવસ્થા કરતી કંપની
examples: I'm going to the travel agency to book a flight to Paris.
The travel agency is having a sale on all package tours to Europe.
She works at the travel agency, helping customers plan their dream vacations.
The travel agency is known for its excellent customer service and competitive prices.

words.english_meaning: Peaceful and untroubled; calm and quiet.
words.gujarati_meaning: શાંતિપૂર્ણ અને અડચણરહિત; શાંત અને ખામોશ.
words.usage_note: Often used to describe natural scenery or a peaceful atmosphere.
examples: The serene beauty of the lake made it a perfect spot for a picnic.
The hotel room had a serene view of the ocean.
The serene music helped me to relax.
The serene surroundings of the forest made me feel at peace.

words.english_meaning: Simple and unsophisticated; relating to the countryside.
words.gujarati_meaning: સરળ અને અસંસ્કારી; ગામના વિસ્તારનો સંબંધ.
words.usage_note: Often used to describe traditional or countryside-related things.
examples: The rustic cabin was a great place to spend the weekend.
The restaurant had a rustic atmosphere with wooden tables and chairs.
The rustic road was difficult to drive on.
The rustic village was surrounded by beautiful countryside.

words.english_meaning: Relating to the countryside; pastoral.
words.gujarati_meaning: ગામના વિસ્તારનો સંબંધ; ચરાઈ.
words.usage_note: Often used to describe idyllic or peaceful countryside scenes.
examples: The bucolic scenery of the rolling hills and green pastures was breathtaking.
The bucolic life of the village was far removed from the hustle and bustle of the city.
The bucolic atmosphere of the countryside was perfect for a relaxing vacation.
The bucolic landscape of the painting depicted a peaceful rural scene.

words.english_meaning: Having a mixture of different cultures and ethnic groups; international.
words.gujarati_meaning: વિવિધ સંસ્કૃતિઓ અને જાતિય જૂથોનું મિશ્રણ; આંતરરાષ્ટ્રીય.
words.usage_note: Often used to describe cities or societies with a diverse population.
examples: The cosmopolitan city of New York has people from all over the world.
The cosmopolitan culture of the university was reflected in its diverse student body.
The cosmopolitan society of the city was tolerant of different lifestyles.
The cosmopolitan atmosphere of the restaurant was enhanced by its international cuisine.

words.english_meaning: Extremely happy or peaceful; highly pleasing.
words.gujarati_meaning: અત્યંત સુખી અથવા શાંત; ખૂબ જ રૂચિકર.
words.usage_note: Often used to describe a highly pleasing or peaceful situation.
examples: The idyllic scenery of the beach made it a perfect spot for a romantic getaway.
The idyllic life of the village was far removed from the stress of the city.
The idyllic atmosphere of the garden was perfect for a relaxing afternoon.
The idyllic landscape of the painting depicted a peaceful rural scene.

words.english_meaning: Growing thickly and healthily; rich and luxurious.
words.gujarati_meaning: ગાઢ અને સ્વસ્થ રીતે વધતું; સમૃદ્ધ અને વિલાસિત.
words.usage_note: Often used to describe plants or natural scenery.
examples: The lush greenery of the forest was a sight to behold.
The lush gardens of the palace were famous for their beauty.
The lush vegetation of the island was home to a wide variety of wildlife.
The lush landscape of the painting depicted a thriving ecosystem.

words.english_meaning: Impressively beautiful or dignified; grand.
words.gujarati_meaning: પ્રભાવશાળી રીતે સુંદર અથવા ગંભીર; મહાન.
words.usage_note: Often used to describe something that inspires awe or admiration.
examples: The majestic scenery of the Grand Canyon was breathtaking.
The majestic architecture of the palace was a testament to its rich history.
The majestic mountains of the Himalayas were a challenge to climb.
The majestic landscape of the painting depicted a powerful and awe-inspiring scene.

words.english_meaning: Harsh or extreme; strict or stern.
words.gujarati_meaning: કઠોર અથવા અતિશય; કડક અથવા સખત.
words.usage_note: Often used to describe something that is harsh or extreme.
examples: The severe weather warning was issued for the entire state.
The severe punishment for the crime was a deterrent to others.
The severe critic of the movie was not impressed by its plot.
The severe landscape of the desert was unforgiving to travelers.

words.english_meaning: Extremely good or impressive; worthy of attention.
words.gujarati_meaning: અત્યંત સારું અથવા પ્રભાવશાળી; ધ્યાન આપવા યોગ્ય.
words.usage_note: Often used to describe something that is impressive or attention-grabbing.
examples: The spectacular scenery of the fireworks display was enjoyed by all.
The spectacular performance of the musician was applauded by the audience.
The spectacular architecture of the building was a marvel of engineering.
The spectacular landscape of the painting depicted a vibrant and dynamic scene.

words.english_meaning: Full of energy and life; bright and colorful.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઊર્જાસભર અને જીવંત; તેજસ્વી અને રંગબેરંગી.
words.usage_note: Often used to describe something that is full of energy or life.
examples: The vibrant colors of the painting made it stand out.
The vibrant music of the festival was enjoyed by all.
The vibrant atmosphere of the city was infectious.
The vibrant landscape of the garden was full of life and color.

words.english_meaning: Near or close to a place
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ સ્થળની નજીક અથવા આસપાસ
collocations: in the vicinity of the city
words.usage_note: Used to describe something that is near or close to a place
examples: The hotel is in the vicinity of the airport
There are several restaurants in the vicinity
The new school is in the vicinity of our house
The police station is in the vicinity of the city center

words.english_meaning: At the edge or boundary of a town or city
words.gujarati_meaning: શહેર અથવા નગરની સીમા પર
words.usage_note: Used to describe something that is located at the edge or boundary of a town or city
examples: The new shopping mall is on the outskirts of the city
The factory is located on the outskirts of town
The hotel is on the outskirts of the airport
The university is on the outskirts of the city center

words.english_meaning: In the center or middle of something
words.gujarati_meaning: કંઈકના મધ્યમાં અથવા વચ્ચે
collocations: in the middle of the city
in the middle of the night
in the middle of the forest
words.usage_note: Used to describe something that is located in the center or middle of something
examples: The park is in the middle of the city
The hotel is in the middle of the town
The restaurant is in the middle of the forest
The university is in the middle of the city center

words.english_meaning: At the base or bottom of something
words.gujarati_meaning: કંઈકના પાયા અથવા તળિયે
collocations: at the foot of the mountain
at the foot of the hill
at the foot of the statue
words.usage_note: Used to describe something that is located at the base or bottom of something
examples: The village is at the foot of the mountain
The hotel is at the foot of the hill
The monument is at the foot of the statue
The city is at the foot of the valley

words.english_meaning: Next to or adjacent to something
words.gujarati_meaning: કંઈકની બાજુમાં અથવા પાસે
collocations: by the side of the road
by the side of the river
by the side of the house
words.usage_note: Used to describe something that is located next to or adjacent to something
examples: The park is by the side of the road
The hotel is by the side of the river
The restaurant is by the side of the house
The university is by the side of the city center

words.english_meaning: On the opposite side of something
words.gujarati_meaning: કંઈકની સામેની બાજુએ
words.usage_note: Used to describe something that is located on the opposite side of something
examples: The coffee shop is across from the park
The hotel is across from the restaurant
The university is across from the city center
The library is across from the bookstore

words.english_meaning: On the other side of something
words.gujarati_meaning: કંઈકની વિરુદ્ધ બાજુએ
collocations: on the opposite side of the street
on the opposite side of the room
on the opposite side of the table
words.usage_note: Used to describe something that is located on the other side of something
examples: The restaurant is on the opposite side of the street
The hotel is on the opposite side of the park
The university is on the opposite side of the city center
The library is on the opposite side of the bookstore

words.english_meaning: At a short distance away
words.gujarati_meaning: નજીકમાં અથવા આસપાસ
words.usage_note: Used to describe something that is at a short distance away
examples: There is a shop nearby
The hotel is nearby
The restaurant is nearby
The university is nearby

words.english_meaning: Near or close to something
words.gujarati_meaning: કંઈકની નજીક અથવા આસપાસ
collocations: in close proximity to the city
in close proximity to the airport
in close proximity to the university
words.usage_note: Used to describe something that is near or close to something
examples: The hotel is in close proximity to the airport
The restaurant is in close proximity to the university
The park is in close proximity to the city center
The library is in close proximity to the bookstore

words.english_meaning: Close enough to hear something
words.gujarati_meaning: કંઈક સાંભળવા માટે પૂરતી નજીક
words.usage_note: Used to describe something that is close enough to hear something
examples: The hotel room is within earshot of the music
The conversation is within earshot of the noise
The university is within earshot of the city center
The library is within earshot of the bookstore

mini_dialogues.title: Describing where you live
mini_dialogues.situation: A new colleague asks about your area.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: What's the neighbourhood like where you live?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: It's a quiet residential area on the outskirts of town.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Isn't that far from downtown?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Not really — the metro is within walking distance.

mini_dialogues.title: At the railway station
mini_dialogues.situation: You need to find your train and a snack.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Excuse me, which platform is the train to Pune?

turns.speaker: Staff
turns.text: Platform four. It's a major junction, so check the board.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Is there somewhere to grab a snack?

turns.speaker: Staff
turns.text: There's a kiosk near the terminal entrance.

mini_dialogues.title: Talking about a holiday spot
mini_dialogues.situation: A friend asks about your trip to the hills.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: How was the hill station?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Picturesque and wonderfully secluded — really off the beaten track.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Wasn't it too remote?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: A bit — it felt miles from anywhere, but that was the charm.

mini_dialogues.title: Renting a shop space
mini_dialogues.situation: You're looking for a place to open a business.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I'm looking for premises to open a boutique.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: There's a spacious outlet in the heart of the market.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Is it in good condition?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Yes, freshly renovated — not run-down at all.

mini_dialogues.title: Finding your house
mini_dialogues.situation: You explain how easy your home is to find.

turns.speaker: Guest
turns.text: Where exactly is your place?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: In a lovely old locality, full of quaint little houses.

turns.speaker: Guest
turns.text: Easy to find?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Very — there's a pharmacy right on the doorstep, you can't miss it.

words.english_meaning: A short trip taken for pleasure.
words.gujarati_meaning: મોજમજા માટેની ટૂંકી સહેલ / ફરવા જવાનું.
words.usage_note: A pleasure trip, usually for a day or less.
examples: We went on a family outing to the lake.
The school organised an outing to the zoo.
A weekend outing is a great way to relax.
Pack some snacks for the outing.

words.english_meaning: A short holiday taken to escape from everyday life.
words.gujarati_meaning: રોજિંદી ભાગદોડથી દૂર ટૂંકું વેકેશન / છૂટકારો.
words.usage_note: Informal; suggests a relaxing short escape.
examples: We booked a weekend getaway to the hills.
A short getaway can refresh your mind.
They planned a quiet getaway by the sea.
The resort is perfect for a quick getaway.

words.english_meaning: A short organised trip, often in a group, for leisure or learning.
words.gujarati_meaning: આયોજિત ટૂંકી સફર / સહેલ.
words.usage_note: Slightly formal; often a planned or guided group trip.
examples: The hotel offers excursions to nearby villages.
We took a boat excursion along the coast.
The class went on an excursion to the museum.
A guided excursion made the trip easier.

words.english_meaning: A journey to a place and back again on the same day.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક જ દિવસમાં પૂરી થતી સફર.
words.usage_note: No overnight stay — you return the same day.
examples: We took a day trip to the beach.
It's an easy day trip from the city.
They went on a day trip to the old fort.
A day trip needs less packing than a holiday.

words.english_meaning: A planned route or schedule for a journey or trip.
words.gujarati_meaning: પ્રવાસનો આયોજિત માર્ગ / કાર્યક્રમ.
words.usage_note: Formal; the day-by-day plan of a trip. (Said 'eye-TIN-er-ree'.)
examples: Our itinerary includes three cities in five days.
She prepared a detailed itinerary for the tour.
Check the itinerary before you pack.
The guide handed us the day's itinerary.

words.english_meaning: The place where an event or activity happens.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ કાર્યક્રમ / મેળાવડો યોજાય તે સ્થળ.
words.usage_note: Used for events — parties, picnics, concerts, meetings.
examples: The park is a great venue for a picnic.
They booked a riverside venue for the party.
The venue was changed due to rain.
We chose a shady venue for the gathering.

words.english_meaning: An event where a group of people come together.
words.gujarati_meaning: લોકોનો મેળાવડો / ભેગા થવું.
words.usage_note: Any event where people meet — informal or formal.
examples: We had a small family gathering in the garden.
The picnic turned into a happy gathering.
It was a quiet gathering of close friends.
Such gatherings bring everyone together.

words.english_meaning: A basket, usually with a lid, packed with food for a picnic.
words.gujarati_meaning: પિકનિક માટે ખાવાનું ભરેલી ઢાંકણાવાળી ટોપલી.
words.usage_note: A picnic hamper holds food; a 'gift hamper' is a basket of gifts.
examples: She packed sandwiches into the picnic hamper.
We carried a hamper full of treats.
The hamper had a flask and some fruit.
They received a lovely gift hamper.

words.english_meaning: A blanket or mat spread on the ground to sit on during a picnic.
words.gujarati_meaning: જમીન પર બેસવા માટેનું પાથરણું / ચાદર.
words.usage_note: British term; 'rug' here means a thick blanket for sitting outdoors.
examples: We spread the picnic rug under a tree.
Everyone sat on the picnic rug to eat.
Don't forget the picnic rug for the grass.
The rug kept us off the damp ground.

words.english_meaning: A container that keeps drinks hot or cold for a long time.
words.gujarati_meaning: પીણું ગરમ કે ઠંડું રાખવાનું પાત્ર / થર્મોસ.
words.usage_note: A 'flask' (or 'thermos') keeps tea/coffee hot on outings.
examples: I filled a flask with hot tea for the trip.
Keep the coffee in a flask to stay warm.
She poured soup from the flask.
A cold-water flask is useful in summer.

words.english_meaning: Knives, forks, and spoons used for eating.
words.gujarati_meaning: છરી, કાંટો, ચમચી વગેરે જમવાનાં સાધનો.
words.usage_note: Uncountable; 'a piece of cutlery'. For picnics, often disposable.
examples: Pack some cutlery for the picnic.
We used plastic cutlery to save washing up.
The cutlery was wrapped in napkins.
Don't forget spoons in the cutlery set.

words.english_meaning: Light food and drinks served at an event or during a trip.
words.gujarati_meaning: હળવો નાસ્તો અને પીણાં.
words.usage_note: Usually plural; light snacks/drinks rather than a full meal.
examples: Light refreshments were served at the picnic.
We packed plenty of refreshments.
Refreshments will be available at the venue.
After the hike, we stopped for refreshments.

words.english_meaning: Food that remains uneaten after a meal.
words.gujarati_meaning: જમ્યા પછી વધેલું ખાવાનું.
words.usage_note: Usually plural. 'Leftover' (adj) before a noun: 'leftover cake'.
examples: We packed the leftovers to take home.
There were plenty of leftovers after lunch.
Don't waste the leftovers — save them.
We had leftover sandwiches on the journey back.

words.english_meaning: Made to be thrown away after one use.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક વાર વાપરીને ફેંકી દેવાય એવું.
words.usage_note: Adjective ('disposable plates'); handy for picnics but less eco-friendly.
examples: We used disposable plates at the picnic.
Disposable cups save washing up.
Try to avoid too much disposable plastic.
They brought disposable cutlery for everyone.

words.english_meaning: A field covered with grass and wildflowers.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઘાસ અને ફૂલોવાળું ખુલ્લું મેદાન.
words.usage_note: A pretty, literary word for an open grassy field.
examples: We had our picnic in a flower-filled meadow.
Cows grazed in the green meadow.
The meadow was bright with wildflowers.
Children ran freely across the meadow.

words.english_meaning: The land along the edge of a river.
words.gujarati_meaning: નદીકાંઠાની જમીન / કિનારો.
words.usage_note: A popular picnic spot; 'on/along the riverbank'.
examples: We sat on the riverbank and ate lunch.
A path runs along the riverbank.
They fished from the grassy riverbank.
The riverbank was shaded by tall trees.

words.english_meaning: An open space in a wood or forest with no trees.
words.gujarati_meaning: જંગલ વચ્ચેની ખુલ્લી જગ્યા.
words.usage_note: A natural open patch among trees — good for resting.
examples: We set up the picnic in a sunny clearing.
Deer often visit the forest clearing.
A small clearing opened up among the trees.
They camped in a grassy clearing.

words.english_meaning: An area sheltered from direct sunlight.
words.gujarati_meaning: તડકાથી બચાવતી છાંયડી.
words.usage_note: 'In the shade' = out of the sun. Adjective: 'shady'.
examples: We sat in the shade of a big tree.
Find some shade — it's too hot here.
The umbrella gave us welcome shade.
Children played in the shade all afternoon.

words.english_meaning: An area of short, mown grass, especially in a garden or park.
words.gujarati_meaning: સરસ રીતે કાપેલા ઘાસનું મેદાન.
words.usage_note: Mown grass in gardens/parks — a common picnic surface.
examples: We laid the rug on the soft lawn.
The park has a wide green lawn.
Children rolled on the lawn.
We had tea on the lawn behind the house.

words.english_meaning: A small group of trees.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઝાડનો નાનો સમૂહ / ઝાડી.
words.usage_note: Often named by tree type: 'mango grove', 'orange grove'.
examples: We rested in a cool mango grove.
The grove offered plenty of shade.
Birds sang in the orange grove.
A small grove stood beside the field.

words.english_meaning: A path or track through the countryside or a natural area.
words.gujarati_meaning: કુદરત વચ્ચેથી પસાર થતી પગદંડી / કેડી.
words.usage_note: A marked path for walking/hiking in nature.
examples: We followed a nature trail through the woods.
The hiking trail leads to a waterfall.
Stay on the trail so you don't get lost.
The trail was lined with wildflowers.

words.english_meaning: To walk in a slow, relaxed way; a leisurely walk.
words.gujarati_meaning: નિરાંતે, આરામથી ચાલવું / લટાર મારવી.
words.usage_note: Both verb and noun; a relaxed, unhurried walk.
examples: We went for a stroll along the river.
An evening stroll helps me relax.
They strolled through the park hand in hand.
After lunch, we took a slow stroll.

words.english_meaning: To walk around in a relaxed way without a fixed route or purpose.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ નક્કી માર્ગ વગર આમતેમ ફરવું.
words.usage_note: 'Wander around' = explore aimlessly; 'wander off' = stray away.
examples: We wandered around the old town for hours.
Don't wander off too far from the group.
They wandered through the gardens.
I love to wander with no plan.

words.english_meaning: The activity of visiting interesting places, especially as a tourist.
words.gujarati_meaning: પ્રેક્ષણીય સ્થળો જોવા જવું.
words.usage_note: Usually 'go sightseeing'; visiting attractions.
examples: We spent the morning sightseeing in the city.
A sightseeing tour covered all the main spots.
After the picnic, we went sightseeing.
There's plenty of sightseeing to do here.

words.english_meaning: To relax and stop feeling anxious or tense.
words.gujarati_meaning: તણાવ ભૂલીને હળવા થવું / આરામ કરવો.
words.usage_note: To release stress; a getaway is a good way to unwind.
examples: A day in nature helps me unwind.
We went to the lake to unwind.
She unwinds by reading in the garden.
Picnics are a lovely way to unwind.

words.english_meaning: An outdoor meal where food is cooked over a fire or grill; also the grill itself.
words.gujarati_meaning: ખુલ્લામાં શેકીને જમવાનો કાર્યક્રમ / શેકેલું ભોજન.
words.usage_note: Both the event and the cooking equipment. Short form: 'BBQ'.
examples: We had a barbecue in the backyard.
They grilled vegetables on the barbecue.
A barbecue is perfect for a summer outing.
The smell of the barbecue filled the air.

words.english_meaning: A long walk in the countryside or mountains, for pleasure or exercise.
words.gujarati_meaning: કુદરતમાં લાંબી પગપાળા સફર.
words.usage_note: Longer and more energetic than a stroll; done in nature.
examples: We went for a hike up the hill.
The hike offered stunning views.
Wear good shoes for the long hike.
After the hike, we rested in the shade.

words.english_meaning: To sit or lie in a relaxed, lazy way.
words.gujarati_meaning: આળસથી પડ્યા રહીને આરામ કરવો.
words.usage_note: As a verb = relax lazily; (also a noun meaning a sitting room).
examples: We lounged on the grass after lunch.
They spent the afternoon lounging by the pool.
I love to lounge in the shade with a book.
We just lounged around and did nothing.

words.english_meaning: (Of the sky) covered with grey clouds; dull and cloudy.
words.gujarati_meaning: વાદળછાયું, સૂર્ય વગરનું આકાશ.
words.usage_note: Describes a fully cloudy sky (but not necessarily raining).
examples: The sky was overcast, so we took umbrellas.
It stayed overcast all afternoon.
An overcast day kept the picnic cool.
Despite the overcast sky, we had fun.

words.english_meaning: A gentle, light wind.
words.gujarati_meaning: હળવો, ઠંડો પવન.
words.usage_note: A pleasant light wind. Adjective: 'breezy'.
examples: A cool breeze made the picnic pleasant.
We enjoyed the gentle breeze by the river.
The sea breeze felt refreshing.
Leaves rustled in the soft breeze.

words.english_meaning: Light rain made of very fine drops.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઝરમર / હળવો વરસાદ.
words.usage_note: Both noun and verb; gentle, fine rain.
examples: A light drizzle began as we ate.
We carried on despite the drizzle.
It started to drizzle in the afternoon.
The drizzle soon stopped and the sun came out.

words.english_meaning: Extremely hot.
words.gujarati_meaning: અતિશય ગરમ, બાળી નાખે એવો તડકો.
words.usage_note: A strong word for very hot weather.
examples: It was a scorching day, so we stayed in the shade.
We avoided the scorching afternoon sun.
The scorching heat made us thirsty.
Carry water on a scorching day.

words.english_meaning: (Of air or weather) damp and sticky, with a lot of moisture.
words.gujarati_meaning: ભેજવાળું, ચીકાશભર્યું વાતાવરણ.
words.usage_note: Often paired with 'hot and humid'. Noun: 'humidity'.
examples: The weather was hot and humid.
It felt humid before the rain.
A humid afternoon left us sweaty.
The coast is very humid in summer.

words.english_meaning: Enjoyable, nice, and agreeable.
words.gujarati_meaning: સુખદ, સરસ (વાતાવરણ).
words.usage_note: Common for mild, comfortable weather or a nice time.
examples: The weather was pleasant for a picnic.
We had a pleasant afternoon by the lake.
A pleasant breeze cooled the air.
It was a pleasant change from the city heat.

words.english_meaning: Outdoors; in the fresh air rather than inside a building.
words.gujarati_meaning: ખુલ્લી હવામાં / બહાર, મકાનની બહાર.
words.usage_note: Emphasises being outside in fresh air.
words.memory_tip: ખુલ્લી હવામાં = in the open air.
examples: Eating in the open air feels wonderful.
We slept in the open air under the stars.
The concert was held in the open air.
There's nothing like exercise in the open air.

words.english_meaning: To use or enjoy something as much as possible.
words.gujarati_meaning: તકનો પૂરેપૂરો લાભ લેવો.
collocations: make the most of the day
words.usage_note: Idiom — get the maximum benefit or enjoyment.
words.memory_tip: પૂરેપૂરો લાભ લેવો = make the most of.
examples: Let's make the most of this sunny day.
We made the most of our short holiday.
Make the most of your time outdoors.
They made the most of the long weekend.

words.english_meaning: A new and different environment that makes you feel refreshed.
words.gujarati_meaning: વાતાવરણ / સ્થળ બદલવાથી મળતી તાજગી.
words.usage_note: Idiom — going somewhere different for a refreshing break.
words.memory_tip: સ્થળ બદલવાથી તાજગી = a change of scenery.
examples: A picnic gives us a nice change of scenery.
I needed a change of scenery after a busy week.
The countryside was a welcome change of scenery.
Sometimes a change of scenery lifts your mood.

words.english_meaning: So perfect and beautiful that it looks like a picture.
words.gujarati_meaning: ચિત્ર જેવું તદ્દન સંપૂર્ણ અને સુંદર.
words.usage_note: Strongly positive — ideal and lovely.
examples: We found a picture-perfect spot for the picnic.
The weather was picture-perfect.
It was a picture-perfect day by the sea.
The valley looked picture-perfect at sunset.

words.english_meaning: Relaxed and easy-going; not worried or in a hurry.
words.gujarati_meaning: શાંત, નિરાંતભર્યું, બેફિકર.
words.usage_note: Describes a relaxed mood, person, or atmosphere.
examples: The picnic had a lovely laid-back feel.
He has a very laid-back attitude.
We spent a laid-back afternoon by the river.
It was a laid-back gathering with no rush.

words.english_meaning: So beautiful or impressive that it amazes you.
words.gujarati_meaning: શ્વાસ થંભાવી દે એવું અતિ સુંદર / અદ્ભુત.
words.usage_note: Strongly positive — for stunning views or scenery.
words.memory_tip: શ્વાસ થંભાવી દે એવું સુંદર = breathtaking.
examples: The view from the hilltop was breathtaking.
We enjoyed breathtaking scenery on the trail.
The sunset over the sea was breathtaking.
It's a breathtaking spot for a picnic.

mini_dialogues.title: Planning the picnic
mini_dialogues.situation: Two friends plan a weekend outing.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Shall we go on a picnic this weekend?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes! Let's plan a day trip to the meadow on the riverbank.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I'll prepare the itinerary and pack the hamper.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Great — let's make the most of the good weather.

mini_dialogues.title: Choosing a spot
mini_dialogues.situation: You arrive and look for the perfect place to settle.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Where should we set up?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Let's find some shade — it's scorching today.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: There's a lovely clearing near that grove of trees.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Perfect. Spread the picnic rug there.

mini_dialogues.title: Talking about the weather
mini_dialogues.situation: You check the sky during the picnic.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: The sky looks a bit overcast.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: There's a cool breeze too — quite pleasant, actually.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: As long as it doesn't drizzle.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Even if it does, we'll just lounge under the umbrella.

mini_dialogues.title: Enjoying the moment
mini_dialogues.situation: You relax and admire the view.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: This is such a laid-back afternoon.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: I know — eating in the open air is the best.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: The view across the valley is breathtaking.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Definitely a picture-perfect spot.

mini_dialogues.title: Wrapping up
mini_dialogues.situation: The outing is ending and you pack up.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Should we pack up the leftovers?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Yes, and let's bin the disposable plates.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Want to take a stroll before we head back?

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Sure — a little wander along the trail sounds nice. I really needed this change of scenery.

options: A journey there and back in the same day
A trip with several overnight stays
